name: AutoForge
notes:
**AutoForge 0.3.5**

- **Run workflows from your phone.** Settings → Phone: tick the workflows, scan the QR code with your phone and add the page to your home screen. Tap Run from anywhere while your PC is on - no sign-in, no app needed. The page also lists videos waiting for your approval. Use "New link" or "Switch off" if you share it by mistake; the address changes when the PC restarts (scan again).
- **Local AI with Ollama.** Basic LLM Chain has an "Ollama Chat Model (local)" option and a new "Ollama" credential (http://127.0.0.1:11434). Install Ollama from ollama.com and run `ollama pull llama3.1` once. Free, no API key; clear messages when Ollama is not running or has no model yet.
- **iPhone:** unsigned FlowForge.ipa for sideloading with AltStore or Sideloadly. Android APK and Windows installer included.

### Install
- **Windows:** FlowForge-Setup.exe
- **Android:** FlowForge.apk (allow installing apps from your browser)
- **iPhone:** FlowForge.ipa - unsigned, install with AltStore or Sideloadly
